description:
Found by fz-kdt.44's adversarial review: the main drive_until loop's arbiter
integration (drive.rs, quiescence_woke_work -> changed_since_stall = true;
continue) is unreachable from any fixture compile -- every fixture goes
through product_drive, and the arbiter currently wakes nothing on the pure
agenda path (0 quiesced wakes measured on all three target fixtures). The
branch's behavior when a scheduler Settled-waiter IS woken by arbitration is
untested. fz-kdt.13 will create real scheduler Settled-waiters and should
either cover this branch with a world-level test (a Settled waiter over a
quiesced cycle driven through drive_for) or delete it if the product path
subsumes it. Do not close fz-kdt.13 with this branch still uncovered.
title: Drive-loop arbiter branch (quiescence_woke_work -> continue) has no covering test
